base.initialization: pristine base; no prior trained adapter

evaluation.split_role: exact-match-filtered residual; independent generalization not established
evaluation.baseline_isolation: evaluate pristine base before adapter attachment; never reuse a mutated base object as the baseline
evaluation.schedule: fixed baseline and final candidate comparison; no adaptive tuning or best-checkpoint selection against this split
evaluation.records: per-row immutable identity, token count, loss and bounded generated outputs in private evaluation artifacts
evaluation.metrics: paired token-normalized loss with declared uncertainty; separate capability and governance evaluation still required

remaining_gates: Review source rights, PII handling and source-family/semantic overlap limits.
Bind the final training/evaluation source revision and candidate output SHA to receipts.
Verify CUDA/bfloat16 runtime and a bounded GPU step before the 200-step candidate budget.
Use a durable appropriately scoped credential before its existing OAuth expiry.
Review an evaluation protocol capable of establishing the intended product behavior; data separation alone is insufficient.
